ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~1:12) between the dominant low-intensity (near-black) pigment and localized high-intensity (white) surface marks and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across the entire fluke surface. Distinct high-intensity (white) circular focal spots are concentrated on the far-left distal tip. Sparse, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks are mapped across the left fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels, displaying significant jaggedness and irregular peaks, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by an upward-sloping trajectory in the 2D plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups along the leftmost lateral edge, consistent with barnacle colonization; scattered individual white spots across the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions detected on the left lobe, appearing as white diagonal scratches against the dark background pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serrations and small notches along the trailing edge boundary; multiple linear rake marks on the left lobe and heavy barnacle encrustation on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly localized and textured high-intensity cluster of barnacles forming a distinct border on the far-left tip of the fluke.
